name: Brunnenhof
beschreibung: The Hotel Brunnenhof is located in the village of Neustift im Stubaital. It is a family-run house with traditional Tiroler character. The rooms are modernly furnished and have a balcony. The wellness area includes a sauna, a steam bath, and a relaxation room. The cuisine places value on regional products and seasonal dishes. Neustift offers year-round sports opportunities such as hiking, skiing, and climbing.
